traits.name: Hurried Retreat
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The kobold warrior is adjacent to at least one enemy. Effect The kobold warrior Strides up to its Speed plus 5 feet and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. It must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The kobold scout deals an extra 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.
